items.title: River City Food Bank — Midtown — Free Food Distribution
items.description: Free food distribution at River City Food Bank — Midtown (Emergency Food Distribution, CalFresh Assistance). Schedule: Tue, Thu 10:30 AM–1:30 PM. Call 916-446-2627 to confirm before you go — distributions often end early when supplies run out, and schedules change with holidays and weather. Source: River City Food Bank.
